pick.name: brand/ folder in a GitHub repo (+ Google Drive for large files)
pick.what: SVG logos, tokens (CSS/JSON), fonts, guidelines PDF versioned in Git; videos/raw files in Drive
pick.why: Code consumes tokens directly, Claude Code keeps everything in sync, no vendor; AI Pro includes 5 TB Drive storage.
pick.free_limits: Free; Drive storage from AI Pro (5 TB per Google One plans page)

decision: A versioned brand folder is the source of truth that both code and Claude read. Add Canva Brand Kit only when other people make graphics.
